## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `solace-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Set up a Solace pubSub+ broker

1. <!-- manual: Sign up at [console.solace.cloud](https://console.solace.cloud/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Create a new messaging service (select the free plan for development). -->
3. Wait for the service to be provisioned.
4. <!-- manual: Run the Solace PubSub+ Standard Edition container: -->
5. <!-- manual: Access the management console at http://localhost:8080. -->

## Step 3: Create a message VPN

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the Solace management console (PubSub+ Manager). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Message VPNs and click + Create Message VPN. -->
3. <!-- manual: Enter a VPN name (e.g., my-vpn) and configure the basic settings. -->
4. <!-- manual: Enable the SMF service and note the assigned port. -->
5. Select **Apply** to create the VPN.

## Step 4: Create a client username

1. <!-- manual: In PubSub+ Manager, navigate to your Message VPN. -->
2. <!-- manual: Go to Access Control › Client Usernames. -->
3. Select **+ Client Username** and enter a username.
4. <!-- manual: Click + Client Username and enter a username. -->
5. <!-- manual: Set a password for the client username. -->
6. <!-- manual: Enable the client username and click Apply. -->

## Step 5: Create queues and topics

1. <!-- manual: In PubSub+ Manager, navigate to your Message VPN. -->
2. <!-- manual: Go to Queues and click + Queue to create a new queue. -->
3. <!-- manual: Enter a queue name (e.g., my-queue) and configure settings such as max message size and access type. -->
4. <!-- manual: To subscribe a queue to a topic, select the queue and add a topic subscription under Subscriptions. -->
5. Select **Apply** to save.

## Step 6: Obtain connection details

1. <!-- manual: Broker URL: The SMF connection URL in the format smf://‹host›:‹port› (or smfs://‹host›:‹port› for TLS). For Solace Cloud, find this under Connect › Solace Messaging in the service details. -->
2. <!-- manual: Message VPN: The VPN name (e.g., default or the one you created). -->
3. <!-- manual: Client Username: The username created in the previous step. -->
4. <!-- manual: Client Password: The password for the client username. -->
